title: ArcusProjectConfiguration
description: Declarative project configuration (arcus.json) for packaging software for the Arcus v3 distribution standard.

$schema.description: Path or URI to the schema definition.

package_id.description: Immutable package identifier in the Arcus catalog (e.g. opencode-aft, ucs-setup, salvage-horizon).

software_type.description: The Arcus canonical software distribution type.

gateway.description: Base URL of the Arcus Gateway for sequence allocation and distribution.

version.description: Explicit version override. When omitted, version is read from project metadata (package.json, VERSION, etc.).

format.description: Archive compression format. Default is determined by software_type (.zip for games, .tar.gz for plugins).

binary_name.description: Name of the executable binary inside the archive (for cli, service, or game).

action_executable.description: Payload-relative executable exposed as the package's user-launchable action. Omit for install-only packages.

install_only.description: Install the signed payload without exposing a user-launchable action.

service_id.description: Identifier for the background daemon/service (for software_type 'service').

strip_components.description: Number of leading path components to strip on extraction (defaults to 1 for npm pack archives).

executable_name.description: Name of the primary game binary executable.

data_dir.description: Relative path to engine data directory (e.g. SalvageHorizon_Data).

targets.description: Target architecture and URL pattern definitions.

artifact_url_pattern.description: Pattern for downloadable artifact URLs. Tokens: {{PACKAGE_ID}}, {{VERSION}}, {{TARGET}}, {{FILE}}.

paths.description: List of directories or files to include in the snapshot.

post_install.description: Path to hook executable or script run after installation.

post_update.description: Path to hook executable or script run after update.
